note: The owner's manual does not contain a table of discrete error codes (no 'E1'/'Er2'-style codes appear anywhere in the manual text). The machine instead shows a generic warning screen on the LCD display for two documented fault conditions, described below. For any other 'won't turn on' / 'display won't light' symptom, use the troubleshooting table instead (data/structured/troubleshooting.json).

documented_warning_conditions.behavior: A warning screen appears in the LCD Display window and the unit automatically shuts down. It automatically returns to service after cooling off.
documented_warning_conditions.recommended_action: Leave the Power Switch ON so the internal fan can cool the welder. Use shorter welding periods and longer rest periods afterward. See Duty Cycle guidance.

documented_warning_conditions.behavior: Welder does not function when switched on.
documented_warning_conditions.recommended_action: Check input voltage is within the specified range (see Specifications, page 7). If correct, press the Reset Button on the back of the machine.
